instructions.content: Before executing a wave, check its Gate blockquote and confirm any prior wave's Verification checklist is fully ticked; if not, stop and report the unmet gate to the user instead of proceeding.
Resolve each phase's model tier to a concrete model ID via references/model-map.yaml before spawning, defaulting to the standard entry when a tier is absent from the map.
Spawn one Agent tool call per unblocked phase inside a single response, setting subagent_type, the resolved model ID, isolation, description, and the filled per-agent prompt on every call.
Do not proceed past a wave until every agent in it has returned, then stop and report the merge gate to the user, copying the wave's Verification checklist verbatim so they can run each item.
NEVER paraphrase the task description -- copy the verbatim focus or phase file content into the per-agent prompt, since summaries drop constraints, tool names, and scope boundaries.
NEVER omit the model parameter on an Agent call -- omitting it silently defaults to the orchestrator's model and wastes cost on fast-tier mechanical tasks.
NEVER start the next wave before the gate passes -- consolidation agents read files written by prior waves, so unmerged branches produce stale reads and hard-to-detect incorrect output.
NEVER spawn wave agents sequentially -- send a single response with all parallel agents in one message, or the parallelism wave planning was designed for is defeated.
NEVER spawn agents for phases blocked by unmet dependencies -- check each phase's gate/blocked-on annotation and skip and report blocked phases instead.

NEVER trust a merged branch without checking it actually builds -- a merge exiting 0 only proves the text merged, not that the result runs; run the project's own build/test command on main after the merge before ticking the gate.

After the user confirms verification, run wave-execution-planner Mode B on the wave document to tick the checkboxes and mark the wave DONE, then report which wave is now unblocked and continue the loop.
Use this skill when the user says run the plan, execute the plan, start wave N, or launch the agents, for a wave document produced by wave-execution-planner.
